source: Tensor Cores matter enormously for AI because training and inference contain large GEMMs. But they do not accelerate every instruction in a model. Indexing, control flow, many reductions, elementwise transformations, memory movement, synchronization, and host-side work use other resources.
zh: 张量核心对于人工智能来说非常重要，因为训练和推理包含大型 GEMM。但它们并不能加速模型中的每条指令。索引、控制流、许多归约、元素转换、内存移动、同步和主机端工作使用其他资源。
